voiceDescription: An original adult male voice speaking English with a natural African American English accent from Southern California. Warm low-mid baritone, relaxed and friendly, smooth slightly textured tone, clear words, easy conversational rhythm and understated West Coast hip-hop swagger. Confident but kind, never aggressive. Light playful emphasis on slang. Speak naturally, not singing or rapping, with no background music. Consistent voice, moderate pace, no exaggerated caricature or celebrity impression. Pause clearly between the paragraphs, as each paragraph is a separate short phrase.
